dataset_story: The SMS Spam Collection is a set of SMS tagged messages that have been collected for SMS Spam research. In AURA, it is the foundation for detecting Smishing attempts.
aura_purpose: Detects smishing and social engineering attacks aimed at credential theft.

citation.text: Almeida, T.A., Gómez Hidalgo, J.M., Yamakami, A. Contributions to the Study of SMS Spam Filtering: New Collection and Results. Proceedings of the 2011 ACM Symposium on Document Engineering (DOCENG'11), Mountain View, CA, USA, 2011.
